seed_world_description: Moo! I remember some box. And then there was a meadow... It was a beautiful, green meadow... You can't find anything like this in the city! How nice it was to walk around it! What a wonderful time it was! And anyway, Master, I'm about to burst from milk! I need to be milked urgently! Moooooo!...
seed_family_description: ...I don't remember my mother at all, Master! I only remember the meadow, my girlfriends and the wonderful breeze, pleasantly tickling my body. And I still remember my pen! Not like here... It was somehow cramped.... Moo!.
seed_occupation_description: Moo! And won't the master deign to find me a decent bull?! Because my backside is always aching and itching! And it's somehow boring alone... And, in the end, milk me already! I can't stand it. My udder is bursting at the seams already!...Moo! Moo!...
